summary: RoomFit iteration 5 (frontend-only, 390x844, https://roomfit-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Validated the Step 2 revert to the simple-form dimensions wizard and the new Step 3 room-selection screen. All critical review items PASS. Upload flow: start-designing-button -> upload-floorplan-zone opens file chooser; uploading /app/tests/sample_floorplan.png renders upload-plan-image, detection-note reads 'Floor plan uploaded. Automatic wall detection is not used - you will confirm the room dimensions in the next step.', and upload-continue-button is immediately enabled (aria-disabled=None) - no waiting on any AI job. Step 2 after real upload: reference-plan-card + reference-plan-image render the uploaded image (bbox 324x271 after scroll-into-view). dims-uncalibrated path works: room-size-text='--', floor-area-text='--' (NO 4.80x3.60 default). Entering room-width-input=4.8 + room-length-input=3.6 + apply-manual-dims-button -> dimensions-floorplan-svg appears, room-size-text='4.80 x 3.60 m', floor-area-text='17.3 m2'. Invalid width 0.5 triggers dimensions-error. Known-wall scaling: wall-chip-left + known-wall-input=4 + apply-scale-button scales proportionally to '5.33 x 4.00 m'. unit-ft-chip converts to '17.49 x 13.12 ft'; unit-m-chip reverts. door-wall-top + door-pos-end + window-wall-right chips update plan without errors. Empty-dims confirm shows dimensions-error and stays on Step 2. With valid dims, confirm-dimensions-button navigates to Step 3. Step 3 (rooms): select-room-kitchen -> room-unsupported-notice visible, rooms-continue-button disabled; select-room-living -> rooms-continue-button enabled with CTA 'Furnish Living Room'; select-room-bedroom -> CTA 'Furnish Bedroom'. Demo path: try-demo-button on upload step -> demo-notice visible -> upload-continue -> Step 2 prefilled 4.80 x 3.60 m / 17.3 m2 (no reference-plan-card because demo imageUri is intentionally null) -> confirm -> Step 3 with Living pre-selected (CTA 'Furnish Living Room'). Bedroom flow: furniture page displays all four bedroom items (Bed/bed frame, Mattress, Nightstand, Wardrobe) with 'Your selection: 1x Bed / bed frame, 1x Mattress, 2x Nightstand, 1x Wardrobe'. Persistence: full page reload on /plan/dimensions keeps 4.80 x 3.60 m. Direct nav to /plan/rooms retains the confirmed dims in subtitle. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native issues detected: props.pointerEvents deprecation warning (carried over from iters 2-4, non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still fires on initial load (carried from iters 2-4). Non-blocking.

action_items: LOW: Replace deprecated 'props.pointerEvents' usages with 'style.pointerEvents' to clear the remaining console warning.
NOTE: Backend was explicitly out of scope (frontend-only review). Prior iteration_4 backend tests remain valid.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/plan/upload.tsx:40-41 - On every new upload we reset the apartment to emptyApartment() AND the room/dimsConfirmed/roomKind via update({ room: emptyRoom(), dimsConfirmed: false, roomKind: null }, 'all'). This correctly guarantees that a new upload wipes any 4.80x3.60 ghost from a previous demo, so '--' really is the starting state. Verified live.
frontend/app/plan/dimensions.tsx:24-25 - validate() enforces 2 m <= side <= 15 m (200-1500 cm). 0.5 m correctly triggers 'Each side must be at least 2 m (6.6 ft).' Verified.

frontend/app/plan/dimensions.tsx:48-61 - applyScale() keeps aspect ratio when both dims already set and only sets a single side when uncalibrated; this matches the review request 'scales proportionally' for the left-wall=4m case.

frontend/app/plan/rooms.tsx:24,32,34 - 'supported' gate combines FURNISHABLE kinds with state.dimsConfirmed; rooms-continue-button is disabled when either is unmet. room-unsupported-notice is only shown for selected unsupported kinds. Clean.

frontend/src/state/plan-store.tsx:81-82 - Storage key correctly bumped to 'roomfit_state_v3' so stale v2 polygon-editor state is ignored. imageUri still split under IMG_KEY. Persistence survives reload within one browser context.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only run; prior iter_4 pytest 6/6 still valid)
success_rate.frontend: All review items PASS: upload+detection-note+continue-enabled; Step2 uncalibrated '--' default; manual 4.8x3.6 -> 17.3 m2 SVG; invalid-input error; known-wall left=4m proportional scale 5.33x4.00; unit m/ft toggle; door/window chips; empty-confirm error; confirm navigates to Step3; kitchen->unsupported+disabled, living+bedroom supported; demo pre-fills 4.80x3.60 and pre-selects Living; bedroom furniture shows bed_frame/mattress/nightstand/wardrobe; reload + direct URL preserve dims.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Step 2 is now the simple dimensions FORM (not the polygon editor from iter 4). Storage key bumped to v3 so old state is ignored. Key testIDs: upload-floorplan-zone, upload-plan-image, detection-note, upload-continue-button, try-demo-button, demo-notice, reference-plan-card/reference-plan-image (shown only when apartment.imageUri exists; demo has null imageUri intentionally), dims-uncalibrated, room-size-text, floor-area-text, room-width-input, room-length-input, apply-manual-dims-button, wall-chip-{top|bottom|left|right}, known-wall-input, apply-scale-button, unit-{m|ft}-chip, dimensions-error, dimensions-success, door-wall-*, door-pos-{start|centre|end}, window-wall-*, confirm-dimensions-button, dimensions-floorplan-svg, select-room-{living|bedroom|kitchen|bathroom|closet|balcony}, room-unsupported-notice, rooms-continue-button, rooms-no-dims. Playwright gotchas (unchanged from iter 4): fresh browser context per mcp_browser_automation call -> clear localStorage+IndexedDB first and test persistence within ONE script; for Pressable text, use text_content() not inner_text(); style-card-* clicks can be flaky when the Style screen is still laying out - wait 500ms after wait_for_selector before clicking. Downstream style/budget/layouts/shop/results flows were previously validated end-to-end in iter 4 and remain unchanged for this iteration's scope.
rca_of_issue: No bugs reproduced from the user's complaint. The reverted simple Step 2 form plus the new Step 3 room-selection screen behave exactly as described: dimensions are user-confirmed (never guessed from the image), no AI detection runs on upload, invalid or empty inputs produce dimensions-error, the uploaded plan is shown as a reference, and Step 3 cleanly gates continuation on dimsConfirmed + a supported kind (living/bedroom). The user's 'Step 2 generated wrong things and could not get into Step 3' complaint is resolved by this revert.
